substantial_savings: held-out search savings >= 0.75 x primary FreshCache held-out savings (computed at run time by l2_threshold_sweep_scoring.py)
material_improvement: paired exact McNemar p < 0.05 favouring the operating point over primary FreshCache on the same 400 requests, for sufficiency (SUFFICIENT vs not) or for WAI (fresh-correct -> WRONG)
pareto: non-dominated points on (search savings higher, sufficient % of 400 higher) and on (search savings higher, C-WAI lower)
use: descriptive only; no operating point is selected as a new primary policy
